question: You post a 48-megapixel phone photo to Instagram. How many of its pixels does the app keep?
answer: At most about 1.5 million. Instagram stores feed photos up to 1,080 pixels wide, so a portrait comes out around 1,080 by 1,350 and the rest are thrown away on upload. Most phone screens could not show many more anyway: about 3 million pixels. Megapixels pay off only when a picture is cropped or printed large.
